items.q: What should you remember about concept beats idea?
items.a: **trademark + handles +** purpose before market entry prevents costly rebrand/legal fights.

items.q: What should you remember about start premium (premium first pricing): Apple/Tesla model?
items.a: **high-end first, discount later;** hard to go up-market from cheap.

items.q: What should you remember about minimum viable batch?
items.a: **200 units → sell** → 400 → 800; don't over-order before product-market fit.

items.q: What should you remember about negative feedback from non-fans > praise from core community?
items.a: **first hoodie failed outside fanbase as "corporate merch".**

items.q: What should you remember about value communication unlocks price?
items.a: **festival shoppers said £50–55** until quality + mission + try-on → £85 accepted.

items.q: What should you remember about display affects perceived value?
items.a: **piled hoodies = secondhand** shop; wooden hangers + clean layout = premium.

items.q: What should you remember about influencers often free for mission-aligned startups; commission on sales scales alignment?
items.a: **Influencers often free for** mission-aligned startups; commission on sales scales alignment.

items.q: What should you remember about don't pay Zuckerberg for ads when you could pay your community affiliates?
items.a: **Don't pay Zuckerberg for** ads when you could pay your community affiliates.

items.q: What should you remember about airbnb launched website **8 times** before it worked?
What should you remember about even multi-millionaires shouldn't build warehouses before demand?
items.a: **same lean infra advice at every scale.**

items.q: What should you remember about full restaurants go bust because they never calculated true COGS including electricity at home?
items.a: **Full restaurants go bust** because they never calculated true COGS including electricity at home.

items.q: What should you remember about fluid agency?
items.a: **6 years reinvesting all profit before taking money out** — why it scaled.
